title: MIXER -- stereo mixing console with channel strips, busses and master

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Tracks (1-32) and Busses (0-8) set how many strips are built. It opens with 4 tracks, 2 busses.
Strips are rebuilt when the patch opens or a count changes -- reconnect any cords afterwards.
Each channel strip: Gain (input trim, centre = unity), fader with meters, Pan and M (mute).
Ins switches the strip to its insert return inlets instead of its own input.
S1 and S2 set how much of the strip is sent to bus 1 and bus 2.
Bus strips: fader, Pan and M for each bus return.
Master: overall fader with L/R meters; its speaker button turns audio on.

sections.heading: INPUTS & OUTPUTS
lines: Strip inlets 1-2: audio in L/R. Inlets 3-4: insert return L/R.
Strip outlets 1-2: post-fader L/R. Outlets 3-4: insert send (after Gain, before the fader).
Every strip and bus is also summed into the master automatically.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: mixer-manager.js creates mixer-strip and mixer-bus bpatchers via thispatcher scripting.
Each strip's argument is its channel number; sends reach busses over send~ bus-N-L/R.
Strips and busses feed send~ master-L/R, which the mixer-master section receives.
